title: Jack Parsons reads The Golden Bough and concludes science is a form of magic

tellings.quote: And Jack Parsons actually read uh this book called The Golden Bow by JG Frasier, this 19th century anthropologist.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jack Parsons, an American rocket scientist of the 1930s and 40s, read The Golden Bough, a study of magic and religion by the 19th century anthropologist J.G. Frazer. According to Michels, Parsons came away believing that science is a form of magic, which would mean early rocketry grew partly out of occult thinking.
